title: Machine settings
description: The machine file (design part 13.4): what this machine lets hitld use, kept beside the machine-wide registry at $XDG_DATA_HOME/human-in-the-lead/_machine/machine.json (~/.local/share/human-in-the-lead/_machine/machine.json when XDG_DATA_HOME is unset). Data only: unknown and code-running keys are refused. A key left out is not set at this layer, so the next layer or the default applies. Caps and the port range take the strictest layer; a project may narrow them, never widen them. Internal: never committed or synced.

role.description: What kind of machine this is; the role sets the defaults for shares and load checks (design part 13.4, machine roles).

executors_max.description: The most executors on this machine, from every project. The effective cap is the smallest of this, the person's executors_max, the project's execution.concurrency and the run's cap.

env.description: What the environment resource manager uses on this machine (design part 13.2). These were policy.json's env keys.

port_range.description: Dev-server ports are leased from this inclusive range. A project may narrow it; the effective range is the overlap.

worktree_root.description: An absolute directory that holds the worktrees, one subdirectory per holder. A project may name a subdirectory under it.

secret_provider.description: Where secret values are read from: keychain, env, or auto (the keychain, then the environment). A project may narrow auto to keychain or env, never widen it.
